The input lists finance and financial services as its industries and shows funding of about $2.4bn with the latest round in June 2026. The exact asset classes, clients and ownership are not given in the input. Likely a specialised asset or lease finance business, but unconfirmed. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: ExodusPoint Capital Management is a New York multi-strategy hedge fund founded in 2018 by Michael Gelband, formerly of Millennium, investing across macro, equities, credit and systematic strategies on behalf of institutional investors with tens of billions of dollars under management. It earns management and performance fees. Offices in New York, London, Hong Kong, Singapore and elsewhere. Private. Known within institutional finance, no consumer profile.

Neoen is a Paris-based French renewable energy producer developing, financing, building and operating solar, wind and battery storage projects in Australia, France, Finland, the US, Mexico and elsewhere, with over 9 GW in operation or construction. It sells electricity to utilities and corporates under long-term contracts. Acquired by Brookfield Renewable and partners (including Canada's CPP Investments and Mubadala-linked capital) in 2024-25 for around EUR 6bn, and delisted from Euronext. B2B energy firm, little consumer awareness.

STORE Capital was a Scottsdale, Arizona net-lease REIT owning single-tenant operational real estate such as restaurants, health clubs, schools and manufacturing sites, rented to mid-sized businesses. It was acquired in 2023 for about $14bn by GIC and Oak Street Real Estate Capital (Blue Owl) and delisted from the NYSE (STOR). Now privately owned and issuing debt. Landlord business with no consumer brand.

Great Rock Capital is a Westport, Connecticut asset-based lender providing senior secured loans to middle-market companies, including retail, consumer and industrial firms, backed by inventory, receivables and equipment. It earns interest and fees, and is owned by Great Rock Capital Partners Management with institutional investors. Private. B2B specialist finance firm with no consumer awareness.

Elevex Capital is a US commercial equipment financing firm offering loans and leases to businesses buying equipment. The input lists reported funding of about $1 billion, most likely debt facilities, and places it in finance and financial services. No further reliable detail is available on its owners or customers. B2B lender with little consumer awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Suning Finance is the financial technology arm of Suning, the Chinese retail group, headquartered in Shanghai. It has offered consumer finance, payments, supply chain finance, insurance distribution and wealth products to Suning's customers and merchants under the Suning Financial brand. The parent group went through severe financial stress and restructuring from 2021. Consumer fintech with recognition in China linked to Suning's retail brand, which has football links through former ownership of Inter Milan.

wiki.title: Aria
wiki.what: Musical piece for a single voice as part of a larger work
wiki.text: In music, an aria is a self-contained piece for one voice, with or without instrumental or orchestral accompaniment, normally part of a larger work.

about: International Money Express (Intermex) is a Miami-based remittance company that sends money from the US and Europe to Latin America and the Caribbean, mainly Mexico and Guatemala, through agent locations and a digital app. Customers are immigrant workers and their families, with revenue of about $650 million from fees and currency spreads. Listed on Nasdaq (IMXI). Western Union agreed in 2025 to acquire it. Well known among its target community.

Flowdesk is a Paris-based digital asset trading company providing market making, liquidity, over-the-counter trading and treasury services to crypto projects, exchanges and institutions, using algorithmic strategies. Founded in 2020. Customers are token issuers and exchanges. Crunchbase shows about $282 million in funding, which likely includes capital for trading. Private. B2B brand known in the crypto industry, with no consumer awareness.

about: Phantom is a crypto wallet, best known for Solana, now also supporting Ethereum, Bitcoin, Base and Polygon, letting users buy, swap, stake and hold tokens and NFTs through a browser extension and mobile app. Founded in 2021 and based in San Francisco. Revenue comes from swap fees and other services. Has raised about $268 million and was valued around $3 billion in 2025. Private. Large user base with strong awareness in the crypto community.

Istanbul-based Turkish bank founded in 1944, one of the country's largest private lenders, offering retail, SME, corporate and private banking through hundreds of branches and the World credit-card programme. Controlled by Koc Holding, with UniCredit having sold its stake. Listed on Borsa Istanbul (YKBNK). Strong consumer banking brand in Turkey with football and cultural sponsorship, but little international profile. Its customers include millions of retail and business clients in Turkey, with a strong credit-card franchise.

Lehi, Utah-based property management software company, founded 2003, selling the Entrata platform for leasing, payments and resident services to multifamily operators. Valued around $4.3 billion. B2B brand with moderate recognition in real estate; has sponsored sports in Utah. Customers are property owners and managers of apartment communities, who pay per unit. Revenue is several hundred million dollars. Moderate awareness in real estate, none among general consumers.

Kowloon-based online brokerage firm (Lion Group Holding, Nasdaq: LGHL) providing trading platforms and financial services in Asia. Consumer investor brand in region. Customers are retail investors in Asia, paying commissions and spreads. Listed on Nasdaq (LGHL). Small-cap brand with low awareness. Operations are in Hong Kong with customers across Asia. The company provides a trading app and brokerage services, and its customers are individual investors rather than businesses.

New York-based institutional crypto trading platform, founded 2018, offering order management and trading infrastructure to banks, brokers and asset managers. Raised around $196 million. B2B with low consumer awareness. Customers include banks and hedge funds, which pay platform and trading fees. B2B brand with no consumer awareness; known among institutional crypto traders. Talos provides a trading platform with access to many liquidity venues, including spot, derivatives and decentralised finance.

wiki.title: Talos
wiki.text: In Greek mythology, Talos, also spelled Talus or Talon, was a man of bronze who protected Crete from pirates and invaders. Despite the popular idea that he was a giant, no ancient source states this explicitly.

about: London-based payments infrastructure company, founded 2021, providing a payment orchestration platform for merchants. Raised about $173 million. B2B with low consumer awareness. Customers are online merchants who use Primer to connect multiple payment providers through a single integration. Backed by Accel and Index, it is mainly known within the payments industry. Primer's platform includes payment routing, checkout and fraud tools, and its customers include online retailers and travel firms.

Qupital is a Hong Kong-based fintech providing data-driven financing solutions, mainly receivables and supply-chain finance, for e-commerce sellers and global merchants on platforms like Amazon. It lends against sales proceeds and offers cross-border payments. Funding shown is about 470 million dollars, including venture investment and debt facilities. B2B with limited public brand awareness, mainly known within the e-commerce seller community.

about: Pipe is a San Francisco fintech platform that lets companies with recurring revenue, such as subscription software businesses, sell future revenue streams for upfront capital, and trade them with investors. Founded in 2019, it has raised about 450 million dollars in equity and debt from investors including Greenspring, Shopify and others. B2B financial platform with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Pipe (company)
wiki.text: Pipe was a Belgian automobile manufacturer founded by the brothers Alfred and Victor Goldschmidt. The company was also known as Compagnie Belge de Construction Automobiles.

about: Synovus is a US regional bank holding company, based in Columbus, Georgia, with around 250 branches across Georgia, Alabama, Florida, South Carolina and Tennessee. It offers retail, commercial, wealth and mortgage banking with assets of about 60 billion dollars. Listed on the NYSE (SNV), with a 2025 agreement to merge with Pinnacle Financial Partners of Nashville. Strong regional brand in the Southeast US.

Sandfield Capital is a Liverpool-based UK finance firm, according to Crunchbase, providing funding services to legal sector clients, such as litigation funding for law firms and claimants. Recorded funding is about 630 million, probably debt capacity. Customers are law firms and claimants. B2B with low public brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Singapore-based arm of the Taiwanese financial holding Fubon, which offers life insurance in Asia. The parent Fubon Financial is listed in Taiwan. Fubon Financial Holding also owns Taipei Fubon Bank, Fubon Insurance and Fubon Securities, and sponsors Taiwanese professional baseball and basketball teams. Consumer insurance brand with strong awareness in Taiwan.
